caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an upholstered seat. The chair features a dark brown wooden frame with carved details. The backrest consists of horizontal and diagonal slats forming an X shape, with round ornaments at the intersections, and a top rail that curves backward. The seat is upholstered with a fabric displaying a colorful floral pattern that includes shades of pink, green, yellow, blue, and black on a light background. The front and back legs are rounded with vertical grooves, and the front legs are slightly more decorative. Above the chair, there is a sketch of a rectangular decorative wood panel featuring a symmetrical ribbon and foliage design, outlined in black without color. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige or off-white color.
title: Side Chair
